question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is: **around.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"around"** means on all sides or in a circular direction. (चारों ओर)
 
• **"Around"** is the most appropriate word to fill in the blank as it indicates the surrounding area or vicinity.
 
 
• **Example:** There are many shops around the corner.
